subject: Re: AcmeCorp POC - scope re-baseline and additional use cases
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Bob Li <bob.li@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2026-02-25T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: AcmeCorp POC - scope & success criteria (recap + next steps)

Hi Alice / Bob,

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before the POC kickoff. I attached the proposed scope (acmecorp-proposed-scope-v1.pdf).

High-level goal
- Validate Redwood Inference for two priority flows: (1) customer support triage + response suggestion, and (2) knowledge-base extraction for KB population.

Proposed success criteria (measurable)
- Triage accuracy: 80%+ correct routing vs. current rule-based baseline (measured on holdout dataset)
- Response suggestion: 75% acceptance by CS agents in blind A/B over 2-week window
- Latency: 95th percentile token latency < 200ms for 2k-token context on our dedicated infra profile
- Throughput: sustain 50 QPS for inference at target latency
- Operational: integration with our S3 ingestion pipeline and 1-hour cold-start recovery time

Evaluation plan
- Week 0: data ingestion + baseline scoring on past 2k tickets
- Week 1–2: model tuning + daily scoring; interim checkpoint at day 10 to review metrics
- Week 3–4: live sandbox with agent shadowing (no production traffic)
- Week 5–6: canary ramp and joint evaluation against success criteria

Timeline
- Kickoff: target Mar 3 (flexible)
- POC length: 6 weeks from kickoff

Owners / points of contact
- Marissa Cole (rdw): commercial / success coordination
- Camila Reyes (rdw): solutions engineering & integration
- Dev Patel (rdw): infra support for dedicated profile

Immediate next steps
1) Confirm kickoff date (proposed Mar 3)
2) Share the evaluation checklist (I attached a template) and your training dataset access details
3) Camila to schedule a technical kickoff with your engineering team once we confirm date

If this looks good I'll publish an updated SOW and a short amendment for the POC start.

Best,

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@acmecorp.com>

Cc: Bob Li <bob.li@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2026-02-26T09:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: AcmeCorp POC - scope & success criteria (recap + next steps)

Thanks for the detailed recap, Marissa — very helpful. Overall we’re aligned on the plan but two asks from our side after internal review: 

1) Add a secondary use case: document summarization for legal & compliance reviews. That is lower priority than triage, but we want to validate whether Redwood can produce concise, extractive+abstractive summaries for long documents (10k+ tokens).

2) We’d like to add cost sensitivity into success criteria — specifically target cost per 1K tokens that keeps our marginal cost < $0.25 for the summarization flow (rough estimate, we can narrow this during the POC).

Also: can Redwood support ingestion of encrypted S3 buckets (we have a slightly different pipeline for legal docs) and confirm the data residency requirement (US-only) — we need that for the compliance team.

Attached is our evaluation checklist (evaluation-checklist.xlsx) with a couple of fields filled in.

If you can accommodate the summarization use case we may need to push the end date by ~2 weeks to allow for longer-run tests. Please advise on feasibility and whether this affects licensing / costs for the trial.

Appreciate it — can Camila be copied on the next threads for technical details?

Thanks,
Alice
Director of Product | AcmeCorp
alice.johnson@acmecorp.com

Team — forwarding Alice’s note (below) — Acme wants to add a secondary use case (legal doc summarization) and include cost per 1K tokens as a soft success metric. They also asked about encrypted S3 ingestion and US-only residency.

Quick proposed approach / asks: 
- Scope change: include summarization as "secondary" use case with a dedicated evaluation bucket (encrypted) and the same evaluation cadence, but extended test window (add 2 weeks to POC).
- Success metrics: we'll add cost per 1K tokens as a monitoring metric; recommended threshold to propose back is $0.20–0.30 (need engineering to validate).
- Data residency: confirm we can pin the private control plane / dedicated infra to US region (Dev / infra required).
- Ingestion: Camila to own the connector work for encrypted S3; Dev to confirm timeline and any engineering blockers (e.g., signed URLs, KMS key policies).

Suggested owners: Camila (TE lead) for connector and technical kickoff; Dev (infra) to confirm residency & infra profile; Neha (product) to sign off on updated success criteria and timeline. I’ll own the commercial side and customer comms.

If we agree I’ll send an updated scope doc (v2) and an amendment for the POC timeline; we should also flag whether the 2-week extension changes the commercial trial terms (I think we can absorb one 2-week extension at no charge).

Please reply with availability for a 30-min internal sync this afternoon (I propose 4pm PT) or flag concerns in thread.

Hi Alice — thanks for the quick read and the checklist. We can accommodate the summarization use case as a secondary flow and will update the evaluation plan accordingly. Summary of agreed re-baseline below — please reply to confirm and I’ll send the formal SOW amendment/DocuSign for signatures.

What we’re changing
- Add use case: Legal document summarization (secondary). We'll validate extractive + abstractive summaries for long documents (10k+ tokens) using a dedicated encrypted S3 bucket.
- Success criteria: add cost monitoring metric (cost per 1K tokens). Proposed initial target: $0.25 per 1K tokens (engineering to validate).
- Timeline: extend POC by 2 weeks (new total = 8 weeks). New proposed end date: Apr 28 (assuming kickoff Mar 3).

Confirmed owners
- Camila Reyes (Redwood) — solutions engineering, S3 connector for encrypted buckets, technical kickoff owner
- Dev Patel (Redwood) — infra & residency pinning (US-only)
- Neha Kapoor (Redwood) — product metric owner, acceptance sign-off
- Alice Johnson / Bob Li (Acme) — data & evaluation owner

Next steps (action items)
1) I’ll upload updated scope (acmecorp-proposed-scope-v2.pdf) and an amendment for the POC timeline to DocuSign by EOD today. (Link: https://www.docusign.com/templates/amendment-ACME-4782)
2) Camila — please schedule technical kickoff with Acme’s infra team (Alice/Bob) for Mar 3–4 window; confirm S3 encryption connector feasibility and an estimated effort (days).
3) Dev — confirm we can pin the dedicated infra to the US region and any additional configuration notes by Mar 2.
4) Neha — propose final cost-per-1K target by Mar 5 after initial infra/quantization check.

Commercial note: we can absorb a single 2-week extension for the trial period at no additional charge; if they ask for more time we’ll escalate to ops for exception.

Alice — if that aligns please reply and we’ll kick off the technical scheduling. Happy to jump on a call if it helps.

Best,
